candidates.explanation: The snippet for this method is truncated, so I inferred the cause and did not see it directly. The method builds the link from `app.frontendDomain`. It most likely appends '/confirm-email', the same path `userSignUp` uses, instead of a dedicated '/confirm-new-email' route. The email-change link would then open the sign-up activation page. That page posts the hash to `email/confirm`, which calls `AuthService.confirmEmail`. This method expects an inactive user and ignores `newEmail`, so the change never completes. The route that finishes the change, `email/confirm/new`, is never reached. The template path may be wrong in the same way, for example 'activation.hbs' instead of the confirm-new-email template.

fix.description: In `MailService.confirmNewEmail`, build the URL with the frontend's new-email confirmation route: `new URL(frontendDomain + '/confirm-new-email')`. Keep `hash` as a query parameter. Confirm that the frontend page for that route posts to `/auth/email/confirm/new`. Also check that the template path points to the confirm-new-email template and not 'activation.hbs'.
